From what I've read online, I think i neglected to keep up on ferts. With co2 going strong, accelerated plant growth absorbed all the nutrients out of the substrate. After those were gone, most of the plants melted away. This happened in both of my tanks. :(

Oh well. Lesson learned. Now I've got a new scape in my 40 gallon and I think it's looking even better than before. Once it's done cycling, I can move the fish back in and rework my 30 liter tank too. :)

I hope your plants get back on track though! Are your tanks soil based or do you just use tabs? Flourish Tabs work pretty well as far as I can tell!

Right now I'm using a paintball co2 regulator I found for $80 on amazon. 20oz paintball co2 canisters are about $40. It's convenient for me because I live right by a sporting goods store that does paintball co2 refills for $5. I usually only have to refill it about once a month.

I'm using eco complete substrate with flourish tabs. And now that I've learned my lesson, I have calendar reminders to add more tabs every 10-12 weeks.
